title: TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing…
description: A critical missing authentication vulnerability exists in TridotsTech go1cms affecting the master branch through commit 7f68d05 and the version-3 branch before commit ead8da3. The flaw is in the guest-whitelisted update_doc method, allowing unauthenticated attackers to modify any document by supplying a doctype, name, and arbitrary fields. This can lead to privilege escalation, account takeover, or tampering with business data.
